candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record clearly establishes ipilimumab as the causative agent (symptoms arose within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab and recurred with re-challenge), making the drug-induced/immune checkpoint inhibitor etiology an essential diagnostic component. C001 captures the dermatomyositis phenotype and muscle involvement but lacks the etiologic specification that distinguishes this from idiopathic inflammatory myopathy.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies dermatomyositis with muscle weakness but omits the drug-induced/ipilimumab etiology, which is a required component of the benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Muscle biopsy performed post-corticosteroid treatment may have attenuated inflammatory findings, limiting histopathologic confirmation of inflammatory myositis
Jo-1 negativity and post-treatment biopsy showing type II fiber atrophy without inflammation are consistent with drug-induced/immune-mediated mechanism rather than classic idiopathic dermatomyositis
